{{Quote|I must write a paper on that for the Galactic Journal of Endocrinology&hellip;|Beluine|<ref name="Revelation" />}}
The '''''Galactic Journal of Endocrinology''''' was a scientific journal covering endocrinology that was published during the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. After hearing [[Medrit Vasur]] describe the way he had thawed [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] carcasses, the doctor [[Beluine]] stated that he wanted to write a paper about the process in the ''Galactic Journal of Endocrinology''.<ref name="Revelation" />
